title: Instructor in Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences
bio: Dr. Jia-Mahasap is a full-time instructor in the Department of Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences at the Harvard School of Dental Medicine. She teaches in the Advanced Graduate Education Program in Prosthodontics and provides patient care in the Faculty Group Practice in Cambridge, MA. Her teaching philosophy centers on helping students reach their fullest potential, and her research interests include digital dentistry and the development of novel materials in prosthodontics. A Diplomate of the American Board of Prosthodontics, Jia-Mahasap earned her DDS from Chiang Mai University in Thailand. She completed advanced graduate training in prosthodontics at the University of Iowa, where she also earned a Master of Science in oral science and a certificate in prosthodontics. Before joining HSDM, she served as a full-time assistant professor in the Department of Prosthodontics at Chiang Mai University.
